VOTING AGREEMENT

This Voting Agreement is made as of March 18, 2026 among Corvid Optical Systems, Inc., a Delaware corporation (the "Company"), the investors listed on Schedule A (each an "Investor" and together the "Investors"), and the stockholders listed on Schedule B (each a "Key Holder" and together the "Key Holders"). The Investors and the Key Holders are together the "Stockholders."

RECITALS

The Company and the Investors are parties to a Series B Preferred Stock Purchase Agreement of even date, and it is a condition to closing that the parties enter into this Agreement to provide for the election of the Board and for the other matters set out below.

1. BOARD OF DIRECTORS

1.1 Size of the Board. Each Stockholder shall vote all Shares it holds, at every meeting and in every written consent, so that the Board consists of five (5) directors.

1.2 Election. Each Stockholder shall vote its Shares so that:
(a) one director is elected by the holders of Series A Preferred Stock, initially Rosalind Achebe;
(b) one director is elected by the holders of Series B Preferred Stock, initially Ivo Brandsma;
(c) two directors are elected by the holders of Common Stock, one of whom shall be the person then serving as Chief Executive Officer, initially Nadia Oyelaran and Emil Halloran; and
(d) one director not employed by the Company and acceptable to a majority of the Preferred Directors and the Common Directors, initially vacant.

1.3 Removal and Vacancies. A director elected under a clause of Section 1.2 may be removed only by the holders entitled to elect that director, and a vacancy in that seat is filled only by those holders.

1.4 No Liability. A Stockholder is under no liability to any party under this Agreement for any vote cast in accordance with it.

2. DRAG-ALONG

2.1 Obligation. If a Sale of the Company is approved by the Board, by the holders of a majority of the Common Stock, and by the holders of a majority of the Preferred Stock voting as a single class on an as-converted basis, each Stockholder shall vote for it, sell its Shares on the same terms, execute the definitive agreements, and refrain from exercising appraisal rights.

2.2 Conditions. Section 2.1 applies only if: each Stockholder receives the same form and amount of consideration per share of the same class; no Stockholder is required to give a representation other than as to title, authority, and the absence of liens; the liability of a Stockholder is several and not joint and is capped at the consideration that Stockholder actually receives; and no Stockholder is required to accept a covenant not to compete.

3. TERMINATION

This Agreement terminates on the earliest of: the closing of a firm-commitment underwritten public offering; a Sale of the Company that satisfies Section 2.2; and the date the Investors holding a majority of the Preferred Stock and the Key Holders holding a majority of the Common Stock agree in writing to terminate it.

4. GENERAL

4.1 Specific Performance. The parties agree that money damages would not be an adequate remedy for a breach, and that a party may seek specific performance and injunctive relief without posting a bond.

4.2 Legend. Each certificate representing Shares shall bear the legend set out in Section 4.3, and the Company shall not record a transfer that violates this Agreement.

4.3 Amendment. This Agreement may be amended only with the written consent of the Company, the holders of a majority of the Shares held by the Investors, and the holders of a majority of the Shares held by the Key Holders; provided that an amendment that treats a Stockholder differently from others of the same class requires that Stockholder's consent.

4.4 Governing Law. This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of Delaware, without regard to its conflict-of-laws principles.

4.5 Counterparts. This Agreement may be signed in counterparts, including by electronic signature, each of which is an original.
